name: I Am
source:
I am : yet what I am none cares or knows,
My friends forsake me like a memory lost;
I am the self-consumuer of my woes,
They rise and vanish in oblivious host,
Like shades in love and death's oblivion lost;
And yet I am, and live with shadows tost
John Clare "I am"

This is a story of a student Makoto Fushimi.
His only friend was loneliness, but people 
in the literature club change his way of thinking.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE217276.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我是：然而无人关心或知晓我为何物；
我的朋友弃我而去，如同失落的记忆；
我自食忧愁，它们在遗忘的人群中升起又消失，
如同在爱与死亡的遗忘中失落的影子；
然而我仍存在，与阴影共生。”
——约翰·克莱尔《我是》

本作讲述学生伏见诚的故事。他唯一的朋友是孤独，而文学社的人们改变了他的思考方式。
